posts.text:
Pope Leo has issued a stark warning about AI in his first encyclical. Cardinal Czerny tells me "Pope Leo the 13th issued his call for the protection of human dignity without real dialog with those who were imperiling that dignity. This time Pope Leo (the 14th) is issuing the warnings in dialog with those who are responsible for AI... this is an extraordinary step forward."

Video

"The Cuban people are tired... they're tired of feeling like they're just barely surviving." With the Trump administration continuing to pressure Cuba, Cuban-American historian Ada Ferrer tells me "you have a mounting humanitarian crisis piling on top of a situation that was already almost untenable even before January... the situation is dire."

Video

This closely aligns with what the Egyptian Foreign Minister told me earlier this week: nitter.net/amanpour/status/205676…

🚨During the 60-day period, the Strait of Hormuz would be open with no tolls and Iran would agree to clear the mines it deployed in the strait to let ships pass freely

This Memorial Day weekend, we take a moment to remember the sacrifices made by the greatest generation. In 2024, WWII veteran Jake Larson told me why he and his fellow soldiers risked everything to fight fascism in Europe.

Video

This week The New York Times reported that the US & Israel considered hardliner Mahmoud Ahmadinejad as a possible future leader of Iran. From my archives, my conversation with the former Iranian president offers a glimpse at how that may have worked out...

Video

Under skies filled with Russian drones, soldiers on Ukraine’s frontlines move on foot while robots deliver food and ammunition. In this report, @NPWcnn takes us along one road that’s become a vital artery for Ukrainian forces.

Video

Fatherhood “is one of the best things in my life that I’ve experienced,” @RafaelNadal tells me, as he enjoys his post-tennis life. “Difficult and tiring, sometimes, but really amazing.”

Video

In his new Netflix documentary series, “you’re going to see all the success, of course… but on the other hand… the suffering,” @RafaelNadal tells me. The extent of his injuries is extraordinary – and he tells me how his career was almost derailed back in 2005.

Video

Does @RafaelNadal consider himself the GOAT? “In terms of numbers, no,” he tells me. But his Roland Garros record will be hard to beat, he thinks: “You have to put a lot of things together – and in some way you need some luck too.”

Video

Spain’s government is in difficult waters right now, losing local elections and multiple figures close to the PM charged with corruption. Is it time for new elections? No, insists Foreign Minister @jmalbares: “When you see the results in our economy… foreign policy… the rate of employment… There is no reason to stop. And the president is decided to go until the end of the parliamentary period.”

Video

“We are very worried for the humanitarian situation of the Cuban people,” says Spain’s Foreign Minister @jmalbares, after the indictment of Raul Castro. “Everything must be done in full compliance with international law & also guaranteeing the sovereignty & the territorial integrity of Cuba.”

Video

“There is really no military solution” in Iran, Spain’s Foreign Minister @jmalbares tells me. “Of course Iran cannot have the nuclear bomb. Iran must stop the unjustified attacks on the other Middle Eastern countries… I think it’s possible to get an agreement.”

Video

Spain has incurred President Trump’s ire in refusing to increase its defense spending in line with most other NATO allies, as Trump has demanded. “We are delivering in all capacities,” insists Spain’s Foreign Minister @jmalbares. “We are a very committed ally.”

Video

Spain’s government has been outspoken in support of Palestinian rights and highly critical of Israel. Israel’s government has accused Spain’s of being anti-Semitic. Spanish Foreign Minister @jmalbares calls this “absurd and… ridiculous,” adding they are “pro-peace… anti-war.”

Video

“A country that says that it’s a democracy doesn’t behave in this way.” Spain’s Foreign Minister @jmalbares reacts to Israel’s detention of international activists from an aid flotilla. “You don’t inflict such inhumane and humiliating treatment to citizens… I find this appalling, outrageous… and I will never accept that my citizens are treated in this way by anyone in the world.”

Video

This was a fascinating conversation with @RafaelNadal, reflecting on the extraordinary physical and mental challenges he faced over his career. Our full interview airs tonight on @cnni and @PBS
